2:191.text: And kill them wherever you find them, and turn them out from where they have turned you out. And Al-Fitnah
is worse than killing. And fight not with them at Al-Masjid-Al-Harâm
fight you there. But if they attack you, then kill them. Such is the recompense of the disbelievers.

2:192.text: But if they cease, then Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

2:193.text: And fight them until there is no more Fitnah
(disbelief and worshipping of others along with Allâh)
But if they cease, let there be no transgression except against Az-Zâlimûn

2:194.text: The sacred month is for the sacred month, and for the prohibited things, there is the Law of Equality
. Then whoever transgresses the prohibition against you, you transgress likewise against him. And fear Allâh, and know that Allâh is with Al-Muttaqûn

2:195.text: And spend in the Cause of Allâh
and do not throw yourselves into destruction
(by not spending your wealth in the Cause of Allâh)
, and do good. Truly, Allâh loves Al-Muhsinûn

2:196.text: (i.e. all the ceremonies according to the ways of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
for Allâh. But if you are prevented
(animal, i.e. a sheep, a cow, or a camel)
such as you can afford, and do not shave your heads until the Hady reaches the place of sacrifice. And whosoever of you is ill or has an ailment in his scalp
. Then if you are in safety and whosoever performs the ‘Umrah in the months of Hajj before
, he must slaughter a Hady such as he can afford, but if he cannot afford it, he should observe Saum
three days during the Hajj and seven days after his return
, making ten days in all. This is for him whose family is not present at Al-Masjid-Al-Harâm
. And fear Allâh much and know that Allâh is Severe in punishment.
